Overview
What Is Galileo?
Copy page Copy page
Copy page Copy page
Galileo is the leading observability, evaluation, and guardrail platform for GenAI and agentic applications. Designed to empower engineers, product managers, and subject matter experts to build safe and reliable AI applications, Galileo works with all major LLM providers and can be used with your favorite agentic framework , our Python SDK , the TypeScript SDK , or our comprehensive API . Get started below.
